headline: Mohamad Sohibul Iman Inaugurated As New MPR RI Deputy Chairman
seoTitle: Sohibul Iman Inaugurated As MPR Deputy Chairman
metaDescription: Mohamad Sohibul Iman was officially sworn in as Deputy Chairman of the MPR RI, replacing Hidayat Nur Wahid amid ongoing leadership selection discussions.
aiSummaryBullets: Mohamad Sohibul Iman officially replaced Hidayat Nur Wahid as Deputy Chairman of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) of Indonesia.
The inauguration ceremony for the interim replacement took place at the Parliament Complex in Senayan, Jakarta.
Legislative leadership is currently outlining 22 formal requirements for the upcoming vice presidential selection process proposed by the President.
aiContextParagraph: On November 16, 2026, Mohamad Sohibul Iman was formally inaugurated as the Deputy Chairman of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) of Indonesia. The transition occurred through an interim replacement mechanism, succeeding Hidayat Nur Wahid. The proceedings were held at the Parliament Complex in Senayan. Following the transition, the MPR leadership is actively preparing for the selection of a new vice president. Public statements from legislative leaders indicate that there are 22 specific criteria that must be satisfied by candidates proposed by President Prabowo. Additionally, the new leadership has expressed interest in strengthening the institution through potential legislative reforms, including the development of a specific law and the establishment of a council of ethics. This political shift occurs within the broader context of managing executive-legislative relations and internal parliamentary administration for the 2024-2029 term.
whyItIsViral: The story reached a high coverage velocity across multiple national outlets due to the official appointment of a prominent political figure and ongoing updates regarding vice presidential selection protocols.
